column1: # Brasa key bindings: one source for sway/SwayFX, Hyprland and the cheat sheet (Super+F1).
# After editing: Super+Shift+r (runs brasa-gen and reloads the window manager).
# TAB-separated columns: modifiers  key  action  description  [options]
#   modifiers: SUPER, SHIFT, CTRL, ALT joined with +, or "-" for none.
#   key: xkb name (d, Return, space, Left, F1, Print, XF86AudioMute...); "1..9" repeats the line with {n}.
#   action: "wm <verb> [arg]" (close, kill, fullscreen, float, focus DIR, move DIR, ws N, movews N,
#           focusmon DIR, movewsmon DIR, layout-next, reload, touchpad) or "exec <shell command>".
#   options: locked (also works on the lock screen), repeat (repeats while held),
#            release (runs on key release and lets the key through, for Caps Lock / Num Lock).
